Name: Hudson Valley Buildings for Alternative Textures
Author: Kazan22
Description:
[size=5]Hudson Valley Buildings Pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
[/size]
I loved this mod but wanted it to be useable with Alternative Textures so I made this conversion for the following mods:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1478]Hudson Valley Buildings[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42013760]Magimatica[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1980]Hudson Valley Obelisks[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2057]Hudson Valley Winery[/url]﻿ (replaces slime hutch) by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51094596]oomps62[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1771]Seasonal Grandfather Clock[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50604466]endohare[/url]﻿
[/list][size=5]Features[/size]

[size=4]This mod changes the styles of the following buildings:
[list]
[*][size=4]Farmhouse[/size]
[*][size=4]Barn[/size]
[*][size=4]Coop[/size]
[*][size=4]Shed[/size]
[*][size=4]Well[/size]
[*][size=4]Greenhouse[/size]
[*][size=4]Cabins[/size]
[*][size=4]Slime Hutch[/size]
[*][size=4]Silo[/size]
[*][size=4]Mill[/size]
[*][size=4]Obelisks[/size]
[*][size=4]Clock[/size]
[*][size=4]Beehouses[/size]
[/list]
Hudson Valley Buildings has seasonal and color variants:

10 different styles:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Amherst (white base; green accents; green roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Cobleskill (white base; black accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Fahnestock (green base; green accents; brown roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Garrison (purple base; green accents; brown roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Glenmont (red base; blue accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Nantucket (blue base; blue accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Rhinebeck (cream base; blue accents; black roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Saratoga (pink base; pink accents; pink roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Stonybrook (cream base; green accents; brown roof)[/size]
[*][size=3]Woodbury (yellow base; maroon accents; brown roof)[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]How to install
[/size]
[list=1]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file(s) and extract into your /Mods folder or download using Vortex.[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]

[size=3]Recolour your buildings using the Paint Bucket from the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] [size=3]mod.

This mod is just a content pack for[size=3] [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], if the mod isn't properly working, please check with them first![/size]

[size=5]Disclaimer/Bugs/Issues[/size]

[size=3]This is my first conversion for Stardew Valley so there are bound to be things I missed. Certain buildings could not be added probably just due to my lack of familiarity with modding this game.

[/size]Missing buildings:
[list]
[*]Shane's Coop
[*][s]Beehives[/s]
[*]The Island Obelisk (It was missing from the files)
[/list]Missing features:
[list]
[*]I didn't add the vanilla painting option because I haven't gotten that far, yet. I might try to add it later.
[/list]
